# Hummingbirds World

> An interactive explorer of all 363 hummingbird species (family Trochilidae), by Lia Guttman, a birder. Personal and non-commercial.

Each species has its own page with its names (English, scientific, Spanish), its place in the family (subfamily, tribe, genus), weight, bill length, habitat, movement, the countries it lives in, its IUCN Red List status and trend, and a credited photo.

Sources: eBird/Clements Checklist (names and taxonomy), Dickinson & Remsen 2013 and McGuire et al. 2014 (subfamilies and tribes), AVONET (Tobias et al. 2022; weight, bill, habitat, movement), BirdLife International DataZone and eBird records via GBIF (countries), BirdLife International / IUCN Red List (status and trend).

## Pages

- [All 363 species](https://hummingbirds.world/species/): every species, grouped by subfamily and genus, linking to its page
- [The explorer](https://hummingbirds.world/): the interactive site, with family tree, world map, size and status views and a 3D anatomy page
